verdict.rationale: Docs mention that developer replies/reactions 'teach Greptile what matters' and that Greptile can iterate on PR feedback, implying some responsiveness to comments, but no evidence directly shows Greptile answering follow-up questions or executing commands conversationally within the PR thread. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples of Greptile replying to a developer's question/command in-thread with a contextual answer, and independent confirmation of this interactive Q&A behavior.
